label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

report.summary: Outbox publication stalled from ~06:24:50 to ~06:28 while transfers kept committing; delivery attempts failed with connection errors to the consumer. Cause of the refusals is not shown.

findings.claim: Outbox publications nearly stopped (290 vs 721 arrivals) and pending backlog grew to ~400 while arrivals stayed steady at ~30 per 10 s.
findings.reason: Per-bucket publications fall to 0 after the first ~40 s and recover only at the end, producing the late notifications.

findings.claim: Delivery attempts failed with CONNECTION_FAILED (3328 of 3619) in under 3 ms, with no consumer record; only 291 succeeded.
findings.reason: Instant failures with no consumer-side record suggest refused connections to the consumer target, not slow responses or timeouts.

findings.claim: The transfer API, DB pool and DB locks look healthy, so the delay sits in outbox delivery to the consumer, not in request handling or the database.
findings.reason: There were no 500s, no pool pending or timeouts, and no blocked sessions.

findings.claim: Failed rows are retried and accumulate: failed count rose 874 to 1034 and the oldest undelivered age is about 45,900 s, which predates the window.
findings.reason: With maxAttempts=8 and a 1 s poll, the consumer outage burns attempts and rows move to FAILED, which compounds the lateness.

limitations: No consumer-side availability or process logs, so why connections were refused is not confirmed.
The pre-window FAILED backlog (oldest age ~45,900 s) is not explained by data inside this window.
next_checks: Check whether the consumer on 127.0.0.1:18090 was listening between 06:24:50 and 06:28.
Inspect the FAILED outbox rows and consider requeueing them after the consumer is confirmed healthy.

alternatives.reason: Instant connection failures with no consumer log match this, but there is no direct consumer or process status.
alternatives.hypothesis: Consumer at 127.0.0.1:18090 was down or not listening for most of the window

alternatives.reason: The pool had no waiters or timeouts and no blocking was sampled.
alternatives.hypothesis: Database or connection pool contention slowed the outbox
